summary: More community.hrobot deprecations: plans[].month in snapshot plan info, password_mode=set-to-random in storagebox_subaccount, and several subaccount return values renamed under Hetzner's new API.
questions: Is password_mode=set-to-random still supported in storagebox_subaccount?
Which storagebox_subaccount return values are deprecated?

answer_card.title: community.hrobot storagebox subaccount deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `storagebox_snapshot_plan_info`: `plans[].month` is deprecated (always `null` with the new API).
- `storagebox_subaccount`: `password_mode=set-to-random` is deprecated and removed in 3.0.0; it only works with the legacy API.
- `storagebox_subaccount` and `storagebox_subaccount_info`: return values like `homedirectory`, `samba`, `ssh`, `external_reachability`, `webdav`, `readonly`, `createtime`, `comment` (and `accountid` in the info module) are deprecated; see the docs for new names.
